mainProduct.title: Machu Picchu Full Day
mainProduct.shortDescription: Visit Machu Picchu in one day from Cusco, with tourist train service, official buses, admission, a professional guide and assistance throughout the experience.
includes: Pickup from your hotel or address in Cusco
Round-trip tourist train in Inca Rail’s The Voyager category
Consettur bus: Machu Picchu Pueblo – citadel – Machu Picchu Pueblo
Official Machu Picchu admission (circuit subject to availability)
Professional guide in English or Spanish
Transfer to and from the train station

mealOptions.label: Tinkuy buffet at Belmond Sanctuary Lodge

mainProduct.mealDisclaimer: Meals are not included in the base price. Select one option only.

addons.title: Ancestral Welcome in Cusco
addons.shortDescription: Begin your stay with a panoramic route, an Andean ceremony and memorable views of Cusco.

addons.title: Humantay Lake
addons.shortDescription: Hike to the turquoise lake at the foot of snowcapped Humantay, one of Cusco’s most impressive excursions.

addons.title: Vinicunca Rainbow Mountain
addons.shortDescription: See the Andes’ famous rainbow-colored mountain on a full-day excursion from Cusco.
includes: Professional guide in English or Spanish
Breakfast and lunch according to the operating plan
addons.excludesNote: Local admission and the optional horse are not included unless expressly confirmed.

addons.title: Sacred Valley of the Incas
addons.shortDescription: Explore Pisac, Urubamba, Ollantaytambo and Chinchero on a complete cultural route through the Sacred Valley.
includes: Professional guide in English or Spanish
Return to Cusco at the end of the tour
addons.excludesNote: Tourist Ticket and buffet lunch are not included.

addons.title: Seven Lakes of Ausangate
addons.shortDescription: Explore seven high-Andean lakes surrounded by mountains, glaciers and the landscapes of Ausangate.
addons.excludesNote: Local admission fees, hot springs and the optional horse are not included unless expressly confirmed.

addons.title: Cusco South Valley
addons.shortDescription: Visit Tipón, Pikillacta and Andahuaylillas on a half-day cultural route south of Cusco.
includes: Professional guide in English or Spanish
addons.excludesNote: Partial Tourist Ticket and admission to Andahuaylillas are not included.

addons.title: Paracas, Ica and Huacachina Full Day
addons.shortDescription: Visit the Ballestas Islands, Ica and the Huacachina dunes on a complete day trip from Lima.
includes: Boat tour to the Ballestas Islands
Dune buggies and sandboarding according to operating conditions

upsellModal.title: Add more experiences to your days in Peru
upsellModal.text: Machu Picchu is already selected. You can add tours in Cusco, the Sacred Valley or the Peruvian coast, each with its own date.
upsellModal.benefit: Organize several experiences in one booking and one payment.
